note: Ramadan widget content (v8.7.41). k: dua | tip | qadr | fadl (virtues). any: may show before the last ten nights. All items are Quran verses or hadith with their source in sar (Arabic) and sen (English).

items.ar: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.en: The thirst is gone, the veins are moist, and the reward is confirmed, God willing.
items.sar: دعاء الإفطار · سنن أبي داود (حسّنه الألباني)
items.sen: Dua at iftar · Sunan Abi Dawud (graded hasan by al-Albani)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
items.en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.
items.sen: Sunan Abi Dawud (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
items.en: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm on Your religion.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.en: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly and none forgives sins but You. Grant me forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me; You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري وصحيح مسلم
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the next.
items.sar: سنن أبي داود وسنن ابن ماجه (صححه الألباني)
items.sen: Sunan Abi Dawud and Sunan Ibn Majah (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the next, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.en: Our Lord, accept this from us. You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
items.en: Our Lord, do not hold us accountable if we forget or make a mistake.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves; if You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
items.en: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. You are the Giver.

items.ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
items.en: My Lord, expand my chest for me and ease my task for me.

items.ar: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
items.en: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us leaders for the righteous.

items.ar: صُمْ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا: «مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ»
items.en: Fast with faith and hoping for reward: "Whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and seeking reward, his past sins are forgiven."
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ٣٨ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ٧٦٠
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 38 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 760

items.ar: قُمْ لَيَالِيَ رَمَضَانَ: «مَنْ قَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ»
items.en: Pray at night in Ramadan: "Whoever stands in prayer in Ramadan with faith and seeking reward, his past sins are forgiven."
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ٣٧ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ٧٥٩
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 37 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 759

items.ar: لَا تَتْرُكِ السُّحُورَ: «تَسَحَّرُوا فَإِنَّ فِي السُّحُورِ بَرَكَةً»
items.en: Do not skip suhoor: "Take suhoor, for in suhoor there is blessing."
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٩٢٣ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١٠٩٥
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1923 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1095

items.ar: عَجِّلِ الْفِطْرَ: «لَا يَزَالُ النَّاسُ بِخَيْرٍ مَا عَجَّلُوا الْفِطْرَ»
items.en: Break your fast without delay: "People remain in good as long as they hasten to break the fast."
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٩٥٧ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١٠٩٨
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1957 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1098

items.ar: أَطْعِمْ صَائِمًا: «مَنْ فَطَّرَ صَائِمًا كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِهِ»
items.en: Feed a fasting person: "Whoever gives a fasting person food to break his fast has a reward like his."

items.ar: صَلِّ التَّرَاوِيحَ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ: يُكْتَبْ لَكَ قِيَامُ لَيْلَةٍ
items.en: Stay with the imam in Taraweeh until he finishes, and a full night of prayer is written for you.

items.ar: احْفَظْ صِيَامَكَ: «فَإِنْ سَابَّهُ أَحَدٌ أَوْ قَاتَلَهُ فَلْيَقُلْ إِنِّي صَائِمٌ»
items.en: Guard your fast: "If someone insults or fights him, let him say: I am fasting."
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٨٩٤ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١١٥١
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1894 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1151

items.ar: اتْرُكْ قَوْلَ الزُّورِ وَالْعَمَلَ بِهِ: فَالصِّيَامُ لَيْسَ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ فَقَطْ
items.en: Leave false speech and acting on it: fasting is not only from food and drink.

items.ar: أَكْثِرْ مِنَ الْجُودِ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَجْوَدَ مَا يَكُونُ فِي رَمَضَانَ
items.en: Be generous: the Prophet ﷺ was most generous in Ramadan.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ٦ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ٢٣٠٨
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 6 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 2308

items.ar: اقْرَأِ الْقُرْآنَ: «الصِّيَامُ وَالْقُرْآنُ يَشْفَعَانِ لِلْعَبْدِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»
items.en: Read the Quran: "Fasting and the Quran will intercede for the servant on the Day of Resurrection."

items.ar: أَبْوَابُ الْجَنَّةِ مَفْتُوحَةٌ: «إِذَا دَخَلَ رَمَضَانُ فُتِّحَتْ أَبْوَابُ الْجَنَّةِ وَغُلِّقَتْ أَبْوَابُ النَّارِ وَصُفِّدَتِ الشَّيَاطِينُ»
items.en: The gates of Paradise are open: "When Ramadan begins, the gates of Paradise are opened, the gates of Hell are closed, and the devils are chained."
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٨٩٩ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١٠٧٩
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1899 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1079

items.ar: ادْعُ كَثِيرًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَرِيبٌ: «وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ»
items.en: Make plenty of dua, for God is near: "When My servants ask you about Me, I am near; I answer the call of the caller when he calls on Me."

items.ar: الصِّيَامُ لِلتَّقْوَى: «كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ»
items.en: Fasting is for God-consciousness: "Fasting is prescribed for you as it was for those before you, so that you may become mindful of God."

items.ar: الْقُرْآنُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ: «شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ هُدًى لِلنَّاسِ»
items.en: The month of the Quran: "The month of Ramadan in which the Quran was revealed as guidance for mankind."

items.ar: لِلصَّائِمِ فَرْحَتَانِ: فَرْحَةٌ عِنْدَ فِطْرِهِ وَفَرْحَةٌ عِنْدَ لِقَاءِ رَبِّهِ
items.en: The fasting person has two joys: one when he breaks his fast, and one when he meets his Lord.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٩٠٤ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١١٥١
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1904 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1151

items.ar: كَانَ جِبْرِيلُ يَلْقَاهُ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَيُدَارِسُهُ الْقُرْآنَ: فَاجْعَلْ لَكَ وِرْدًا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ
items.en: Jibril would meet the Prophet ﷺ every night in Ramadan and review the Quran with him: set yourself a daily portion.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.en: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.
items.sar: دعاء ليلة القدر · جامع الترمذي (صححه الألباني)
items.sen: Dua for Laylat al-Qadr · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: «لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ»
items.en: "The Night of Power is better than a thousand months."

items.ar: «مَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ»
items.en: "Whoever stands in prayer on the Night of Power with faith and seeking reward, his past sins are forgiven."
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٩٠١ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ٧٦٠
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1901 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 760

items.ar: «تَحَرَّوْا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فِي الْوِتْرِ مِنَ الْعَشْرِ الْأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ»
items.en: "Seek the Night of Power in the odd nights of the last ten of Ramadan."

items.ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْعَشْرُ أَحْيَا اللَّيْلَ وَأَيْقَظَ أَهْلَهُ وَشَدَّ الْمِئْزَرَ
items.en: When the last ten nights began, the Prophet ﷺ would spend the night in worship, wake his family, and exert himself.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ٢٠٢٤ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١١٧٤
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 2024 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1174

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.en: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me. Repeat it tonight.
items.sar: علّمها النبي ﷺ عائشة إن وافقت ليلة القدر · جامع الترمذي
items.sen: The Prophet ﷺ taught it to Aisha for the Night of Power · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the next, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire. A comprehensive dua for these nights.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.en: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly. Forgive me with forgiveness from You and have mercy on me; You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري وصحيح مسلم
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the next.
items.sar: سنن أبي داود وسنن ابن ماجه (صححه الألباني)
items.sen: Sunan Abi Dawud and Sunan Ibn Majah (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا
items.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs, and make our steps firm.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us and have mercy on us. You are the best of those who show mercy.

items.ar: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.en: My Lord, forgive and have mercy. You are the best of those who show mercy.

items.ar: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ
items.en: My Lord, inspire me to be grateful for Your favor that You gave me and my parents, and to do good that pleases You.

items.ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
items.en: My Lord, make me one who keeps up the prayer, and my children too. Our Lord, accept my prayer.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.en: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day the reckoning comes.

items.ar: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.en: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.

items.ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.en: Allah is enough for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

items.ar: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.en: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. I have been one of the wrongdoers.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
items.en: Our Lord, in You we trust, to You we turn, and to You is the final return.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.en: Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us. You have power over all things.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
items.en: Our Lord, turn the punishment of Hell away from us. Its punishment is a lasting torment.

items.ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
items.en: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا
items.en: Our Lord, pour patience upon us and make our steps firm.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
items.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins, erase our bad deeds, and take us in death with the righteous.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا
items.en: O Allah, give my soul its piety and purify it. You are the best to purify it, its Guardian and Master.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
items.en: O Allah, forgive me all my sins: the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the secret.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ
items.en: O Allah, keep me as far from my sins as You have put the east from the west.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ٧٤٤ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ٥٩٨
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 744 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 598

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, weakness and laziness, stinginess and cowardice, the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.

items.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ
items.en: Glory and praise be to Allah, glory be to Allah the Mighty: two words light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ٦٤٠٦ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ٢٦٩٤
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 6406 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 2694

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.en: Sayyid al-Istighfar: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I admit Your favor upon me and I admit my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

items.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
items.en: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, in Your mercy I seek relief.
items.sen: Jami’ at-Tirmidhi · Hadith 3524 (graded hasan by al-Albani)

items.ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.en: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.
items.sen: Sunan Abi Dawud · Hadith 1516 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
items.sen: Sunan Abi Dawud · Hadith 792 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ
items.en: We sent it down on the Night of Power. And what will make you know what the Night of Power is?

items.ar: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ
items.en: In it the angels and the Spirit descend, by their Lord’s permission, with every decree. Peace it is, until the rise of dawn.

items.ar: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
items.en: We sent it down on a blessed night. We were warning. In it every wise matter is made distinct.

items.ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَجْتَهِدُ فِي الْعَشْرِ الْأَوَاخِرِ مَا لَا يَجْتَهِدُ فِي غَيْرِهِ
items.en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to strive in the last ten nights as he did not strive at any other time.

items.ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَعْتَكِفُ الْعَشْرَ الْأَوَاخِرَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ حَتَّى تَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ
items.en: The Prophet ﷺ used to spend the last ten nights of Ramadan in i’tikaf until Allah took his soul.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ٢٠٢٦ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١١٧٢
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 2026 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1172

items.ar: مَنْ يَقُمْ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فَيُوَافِقُهَا إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ
items.en: Whoever stands in prayer on the Night of Power, and it coincides with it, with faith and seeking reward, his past sins are forgiven.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٩٠١ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ٧٦٠
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1901 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 760

items.ar: يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ بِكُمُ الْيُسْرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ الْعُسْرَ وَلِتُكْمِلُوا الْعِدَّةَ وَلِتُكَبِّرُوا اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَاكُمْ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
items.en: Allah wants ease for you, not hardship. Complete the number of days, glorify Allah for guiding you, and perhaps you will be grateful.

items.ar: وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ
items.en: Eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct from the black thread, then complete the fast until night.

items.ar: وَالصَّائِمِينَ وَالصَّائِمَاتِ وَالْحَافِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَالْحَافِظَاتِ وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
items.en: Men and women who fast, who guard their chastity, and who remember Allah often: Allah has prepared for them forgiveness and a great reward.

items.ar: إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
items.en: The patient will be paid their reward in full, without measure.

items.ar: إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ بَابًا يُقَالُ لَهُ الرَّيَّانُ يَدْخُلُ مِنْهُ الصَّائِمُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا يَدْخُلُ مِنْهُ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُهُمْ
items.en: In Paradise there is a gate called ar-Rayyan. The people who fast enter through it on the Day of Resurrection, and no one else enters through it.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٨٩٦ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١١٥٢
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1896 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1152

items.ar: الصَّلَوَاتُ الْخَمْسُ وَالْجُمُعَةُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ وَرَمَضَانُ إِلَى رَمَضَانَ مُكَفِّرَاتٌ لِمَا بَيْنَهُنَّ إِذَا اجْتَنَبَ الْكَبَائِرَ
items.en: The five prayers, Friday to Friday, and Ramadan to Ramadan wipe out what is between them, as long as major sins are avoided.

items.ar: مَنْ صَامَ يَوْمًا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بَعَّدَ اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ النَّارِ سَبْعِينَ خَرِيفًا
items.en: Whoever fasts one day for the sake of Allah, Allah puts his face seventy years away from the Fire.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ٢٨٤٠ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١١٥٣
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 2840 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1153

items.ar: عُمْرَةٌ فِي رَمَضَانَ تَقْضِي حَجَّةً
items.en: An Umrah in Ramadan is equal to a Hajj in reward.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٧٨٢ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١٢٥٦
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1782 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1256

items.ar: أَفْضَلُ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ صَلَاةُ اللَّيْلِ
items.en: The best prayer after the obligatory prayers is the night prayer.

items.ar: كُلُّ عَمَلِ ابْنِ آدَمَ لَهُ إِلَّا الصِّيَامَ فَإِنَّهُ لِي وَأَنَا أَجْزِي بِهِ
items.en: Every deed of the son of Adam is for him except fasting. It is for Me, and I reward it.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٩٠٤ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١١٥١
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1904 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1151

items.ar: رَغِمَ أَنْفُ رَجُلٍ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ رَمَضَانُ ثُمَّ انْسَلَخَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُغْفَرَ لَهُ
items.en: Let him be humbled, the man who lives to see Ramadan and it passes before he is forgiven.
items.sen: Jami’ at-Tirmidhi · Hadith 3545 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: مَّثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنبُلَةٍ مِّائَةُ حَبَّةٍ
items.en: Those who spend their wealth for Allah are like a grain that grows seven ears, each ear with a hundred grains.

items.ar: لَن تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ
items.en: You will never reach righteousness until you spend from what you love.

items.ar: الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِي السَّرَّاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ وَالْكَاظِمِينَ الْغَيْظَ وَالْعَافِينَ عَنِ النَّاسِ وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
items.en: Those who spend in ease and hardship, who hold back their anger and pardon people. Allah loves those who do good.

items.ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَاءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
items.en: They feed the poor, the orphan and the captive for love of Him: "We feed you only for the sake of Allah. We want no reward or thanks from you."

items.ar: وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَامًا
items.en: Those who spend the night prostrating and standing before their Lord.

items.ar: كَانُوا قَلِيلًا مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
items.en: They slept only a little of the night, and before dawn they were asking forgiveness.

items.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ يَهْدِي لِلَّتِي هِيَ أَقْوَمُ
items.en: This Quran guides to what is most upright.

items.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِّمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
items.en: O people, a teaching has come to you from your Lord, a healing for what is in the hearts, a guidance and a mercy for the believers.

items.ar: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
items.en: Say: "O My servants who have wronged themselves, do not despair of Allah’s mercy. Allah forgives all sins."

items.ar: وَسَارِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
items.en: Hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and a Paradise as wide as the heavens and the earth, prepared for the mindful.

items.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
items.en: Indeed with hardship comes ease. Indeed with hardship comes ease.

items.ar: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
items.en: Surely in the remembrance of Allah hearts find rest.

items.ar: وَتَزَوَّدُوا فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ الزَّادِ التَّقْوَىٰ
items.en: Take provisions, and the best provision is piety.

items.ar: مَا نَقَصَ مَالٌ مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ
items.en: Charity never decreases wealth.

items.ar: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
items.en: The best of you is the one who learns the Quran and teaches it.

items.ar: اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شَفِيعًا لِأَصْحَابِهِ
items.en: Read the Quran, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its companions.

items.ar: الْمَاهِرُ بِالْقُرْآنِ مَعَ السَّفَرَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْبَرَرَةِ، وَالَّذِي يَقْرَؤُهُ وَيَتَتَعْتَعُ فِيهِ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ شَاقٌّ لَهُ أَجْرَانِ
items.en: The one skilled in the Quran is with the noble, righteous angels. The one who recites it stumbling, finding it hard, has two rewards.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ٤٩٣٧ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ٧٩٨
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 4937 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 798

items.ar: الْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ
items.en: A good word is charity.
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ٢٩٨٩ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١٠٠٩
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 2989 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1009

items.ar: مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيْرٍ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ
items.en: Whoever guides to good has a reward like the one who does it.

items.ar: مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَهُ سِتًّا مِنْ شَوَّالٍ كَانَ كَصِيَامِ الدَّهْرِ
items.en: Whoever fasts Ramadan and follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted the whole year.

items.ar: مَنْ قَرَأَ حَرْفًا مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَلَهُ بِهِ حَسَنَةٌ وَالْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا
items.en: Whoever reads a letter of the Book of Allah has a good deed for it, and each good deed is multiplied tenfold.
items.sen: Jami’ at-Tirmidhi · Hadith 2910 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: الصَّدَقَةُ تُطْفِئُ الْخَطِيئَةَ كَمَا يُطْفِئُ الْمَاءُ النَّارَ
items.en: Charity extinguishes sin as water extinguishes fire.
items.sen: Jami’ at-Tirmidhi · Hadith 614 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: رَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ: «وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا»
items.en: Recite the Quran slowly and clearly: "And recite the Quran in slow, measured tones."

items.ar: تَدَبَّرِ الْقُرْآنَ: «أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا»
items.en: Reflect on the Quran: "Do they not ponder the Quran, or are there locks on their hearts?"

items.ar: أَكْثِرْ مِنَ الذِّكْرِ: «يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا»
items.en: Remember Allah often: "O you who believe, remember Allah with much remembrance."

items.ar: اذْكُرِ اللَّهَ وَاشْكُرْهُ: «فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ»
items.en: Remember and thank Allah: "Remember Me and I will remember you. Thank Me and do not deny Me."

items.ar: اشْكُرْ نِعَمَ اللَّهِ: «لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ»
items.en: Be thankful for Allah’s blessings: "If you are grateful, I will give you more."

items.ar: جَدِّدِ التَّوْبَةَ: «وَتُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ»
items.en: Renew your repentance: "Turn to Allah, all of you, O believers, so that you may succeed."

items.ar: أَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ الْبَيْنِ: «إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ»
items.en: Make peace between people: "The believers are brothers, so make peace between your brothers."

items.ar: ادْفَعْ بِالْحُسْنَى: «ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ»
items.en: Answer with what is better: "Repel evil with what is better, and the one you were enemies with becomes a close friend."

items.ar: حَافِظْ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ فِي وَقْتِهَا: «إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَابًا مَّوْقُوتًا»
items.en: Keep prayer on time: "Prayer is prescribed for the believers at fixed times."

items.ar: أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ وَآتِ الزَّكَاةَ: «وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا»
items.en: Pray, give zakat and give generously: "Keep up the prayer, give the zakat and lend Allah a good loan."

items.ar: لَا تَنْسَ إِذَا أَكَلْتَ نَاسِيًا: «مَنْ نَسِيَ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ فَأَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ فَلْيُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ فَإِنَّمَا أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ وَسَقَاهُ»
items.en: If you eat or drink by mistake: "Whoever forgets while fasting and eats or drinks, let him complete his fast, for Allah fed him and gave him drink."
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٩٣٣ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١١٥٥
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1933 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1155

items.ar: أَدِّ زَكَاةَ الْفِطْرِ قَبْلَ الْعِيدِ: «فَرَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ زَكَاةَ الْفِطْرِ صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ»
items.en: Give zakat al-fitr before Eid: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made zakat al-fitr obligatory: a sa’ of dates or a sa’ of barley."
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٥٠٣ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ٩٨٤
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1503 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 984

items.ar: صُمْ وَأَفْطِرْ بِالرُّؤْيَةِ: «صُومُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَأَفْطِرُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ»
items.en: Start and end by the crescent: "Fast when you see it and break the fast when you see it."
items.sar: متفق عليه · صحيح البخاري · حديث ١٩٠٩ · صحيح مسلم · حديث ١٠٨١
items.sen: Agreed upon · Sahih al-Bukhari · Hadith 1909 · Sahih Muslim · Hadith 1081

items.ar: أَفْطِرْ عَلَى تَمْرٍ: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يُفْطِرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَى رُطَبَاتٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ رُطَبَاتٌ فَتَمَرَاتٌ»
items.en: Break your fast with dates: "The Prophet ﷺ used to break his fast before praying with fresh dates; if there were none, with dry dates."
items.sen: Sunan Abi Dawud · Hadith 2356 (graded hasan by al-Albani)

items.ar: تَسَحَّرْ بِالتَّمْرِ: «نِعْمَ سَحُورُ الْمُؤْمِنِ التَّمْرُ»
items.en: Have dates at suhoor: "How good is the believer’s suhoor: dates."
items.sen: Sunan Abi Dawud · Hadith 2345 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: ابْتَسِمْ: «تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ»
items.en: Smile: "Your smile in the face of your brother is charity for you."
items.sen: Jami’ at-Tirmidhi · Hadith 1956 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

items.ar: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ: «وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ»
items.en: Follow a bad deed with a good one: "Follow a bad deed with a good deed and it will erase it, and treat people with good character."
items.sen: Jami’ at-Tirmidhi · Hadith 1987 (graded hasan by al-Albani)

items.ar: زَكِّ فِطْرَتَكَ قَبْلَ الصَّلَاةِ: «فَرَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ زَكَاةَ الْفِطْرِ طُهْرَةً لِلصَّائِمِ مِنَ اللَّغْوِ وَالرَّفَثِ وَطُعْمَةً لِلْمَسَاكِينِ»
items.en: Zakat al-fitr: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made it obligatory as a purification for the fasting person from idle talk and wrongdoing, and as food for the poor."
items.sen: Sunan Abi Dawud · Hadith 1609 (graded hasan by al-Albani)
